name: Seikotsuin
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood orthopedic massage clinic: a reception-hours notice, a first day working the front desk, a treatment-menu guide, an online-reservation trial notice, a three-treatment-plan guide, an essay on learning to ask about pain before treatment, a story about teaching a junior how to wrap tape, the clinic's history and how its treatment methods changed, a services guide, a column on how online reservations changed the clinic, a hybrid priority-day reservation system guide, a column on balancing efficiency and in-person care, and a one-year priority-day system report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
